gaps.title: Missing fallback UI flow on SSO errors
gaps.jtbd: When the Moodle SSO is down, I want to be able to fall back to a manual login option, so that I can still access the archive.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a failure to login via Moodle SSO, When the error occurs, Then the frontend should automatically prompt for or show the fallback login form instead of just failing.
gaps.reason: Literal brief requirement: 'Устойчивость к сбоям внешней LMS (автономный fallback)'. The backend handles a fallback_password param for some error scenarios, but the UI has no fallback form logic if SSO fails or is unreachable, except the generic recovery flow.
